Key EventsBusiness Updates
Q3
2025
On 1stAugust 2025, the Krabi MSW power plant received a certificate of recognition under the “Krabi Goes Green” initiative from the Governor of Krabi 
Province. The recognition affirms the plant’s significant contribution to addressing the issue of accumulated municipal waste inthe area.MSW Krabi Received a Certificate of Recognition 
On 24th July 2025 , the Company achieved the commercial operation date (COD) for a solar farm project in Hankha District, Chai Nat Province, with an 
installed capacity of 8.04 MW and a PPA capacity of 4.00 MW, followed by the COD on 7thAugust 2025 for a solar farm project in Phayu District, Si Sa 
Ket Province with an installed capacity of 6.79 MW and a PPA capacity of 3.38 MW.2 Solar Farm Projects COD –Hankha ( 8.04 MW), Phayu ( 6.79 MW)
On 6thAugust 2025, the Company achieved a perfect 100 scores in the Annual General Meeting Assessment by (TIA) for the third consecutive year.Achieved 100 Scores in AGM Assessment
On 21stAugust 2025, TRIS Ratings affirmed the company rating on ACE at “BBB+” with a “stable” rating outlook.TRIS Ratings affirmed Company Rating at “BBB+ ”
On 21st August 2025, the Company achieved the COD for 2 solar farm projects in Ratchaburi Province, with a total installed capacity of 28.16 MW an d a
total PPA capacity of 14.00 MW, followed by the COD on 25thAugust 2025 for 2 solar farm projects in Nakhon Si Thammarat Province with a total 
installed capacity of 28.50 MW and a total PPA capacity of 14.17 MW. followed by the COD on 8thSeptember 2025 for 1 solar farm project in Khon Kaen 
Province with an installed capacity of 10.48 MW and a PPA capacity of 5.21 MW.5 Solar Farm Projects COD

## Page 7

7
Key EventsBusiness Updates
Q4
2025
On 28th October 2025 , the Company was awarded the highest 5-Star ( “Excellent ”) rating in the 2025 Corporate Governance Report (CGR) by the Thai 
Institute of Directors (IOD) for the third consecutive year.5 Stars CGR Score
On 20th October 2025 , the Company achieved the COD for a solar rooftop project in Lahan Sai District, Buriram Province, with an installed capacity anda 
PPA capacity of 0.27 MW.Solar Rooftop Project COD
On 30th October 2025, the Don Mon biomass power plant in Buriram Province, with an installed capacity of 9.50 MW and a PPA capacity of 8.00 MW, 
reached the end of its PPA with the Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA).Don Mon Biomass PPA Expired
On 18th November 2025, the Company achieved the COD for a solar farm project in Ranong Province, with an installed capacity of 6.59 MW and a PPA 
capacity of 3.28 MW.Ranong Solar Farm Project COD
On 14th November 2025 , the Board of Directors resolved to dispose of the repurchased shares, bought back from 1stJuly 2022 to 31st December 2022 , 
totaling 100,365,600 shares, representing 0.99% of the Company ’s total paid -up shares. The shares were resold through the automatic order -matching 
system on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) during 24thto 28thNovember 2025 . As of 28thNovember 2025 , after the end of the disposal period, the 
Company was unable to resell the repurchased shares. Therefore, the Company has decreased its paid -up capital by writing off the unsold amount of the 
repurchased shares totaling 100,365,600 shares, at a par value of Baht 0.50 per share.Decrease in paid -up capital by writing off the Repurchased Shares
On 20th October 2025 , the Company fully redeemed its Debentures No. 1/2023 (Series 1), with a tenor of 2 years and a total value of THB 235.20 million, 
upon the maturity date.Fully Redeems Debentures on Maturity
On 24th November 2025, the Supreme Administrative Court issued its final judgment on the Si Sa Ket biomass power plant, allowing PEA to terminate th e 
PPA and requiring PEA to return bank guarantee in full to the Company.The Reinstatement of Si Sa Ket Biomass PPA came to an end
